title: Lanes: how people participate
summary: Buyer, custom/bulk, builder, paid assembler, designer, affiliate — lanes stack, entry stays low.

blocks.title: Pick a lane — or stack a few
blocks.body: Not everyone wants the same depth. Some people only buy. Some only share. Some build at the kitchen table. The model works when each lane has a clear offer and nobody is forced into inventory or recruiting.

blocks.heading: Six lanes
blocks.caption: Lanes stack. A designer can also be an affiliate; a builder can grow into paid assembler.
rows: Logos for company, club, event; volume pricing
Kits, patterns, a place to show work

blocks.heading: Stacking is the default
blocks.body: A club officer might buy a sample, place a bulk order for the team, then share an affiliate link for fans. A builder might start with one kit, post gallery shots, earn a skill badge, and take paid assembly work. Low entry for designer and affiliate; builders start with a single kit, not a warehouse.

items.label: No buy-in
items.detail: Nobody pays a fee to "join" a lane.

items.label: No required inventory
items.detail: Assemblers are paid per accepted piece; they are not forced to stock rings.

items.label: No recruiting pay
items.detail: Affiliate commission is on product sales only — see Money.

blocks.heading: Content sells every lane
blocks.body: Whatever lane you pick, the next drill is the pipeline: design, build, clip, post, order.
